create.name: Gina Kitzmiller
create.bio:
Gina Kitzmiller is a Reiki master-teacher and intuitive based in Columbus, Ohio, and the founder of Trimatri Reiki, a lineage she says came to her through her own Reiki practice and three spirit guides. Before this work she earned a master's degree in vocational rehabilitation counselling. Her later training spans Usui Reiki, Akashic Records facilitation, Divine I AM practice, breathwork, yoga and Holden Qi Gong, and she is a certified grief educator. Her memoir Soul Walk tells of the years after her husband's sudden death in 2018 and of the sense of continuing contact with him that opened her intuition.

Under the name The Karuna Life, karuna being the Sanskrit word for compassion, she trains Reiki students in small groups and one to one, online and in person, and has put the first level of Trimatri Reiki on Udemy alongside an on-demand course on spirit guides and divination. She also gives a limited number of Akashic Records readings and Reiki sessions, mostly over Zoom, holds online group Reiki gatherings, and is adding Qi Gong classes. Her podcast, The Karuna Life, mixes conversations with other healers and intuitives with short solo reflections, and her guided practices are on Insight Timer.

courses.title: Akashic Soul Guidance Session
courses.description: A private reading in which she draws on the Akashic Records and the client's guides to look at questions of relationships, purpose, recurring patterns and next steps, with a short energy transmission included. Offered mostly over Zoom, with some in-person sessions in the Columbus area.
courses.price: $177 USD (60 min, Zoom); $222 USD (90 min, Zoom); $200 USD / $233 USD in person

courses.title: Private Trimatri® Reiki Training (Level I and Level II)
courses.description: One-to-one training in the Reiki system she founded, about five to six hours per level, with materials, an attunement and a certificate. Level I covers self-practice and giving Reiki to family, friends and animals; Level II is the practitioner certification.
courses.price: Level I: $499 USD (Zoom), $599 USD (in person); Level II: $599 USD (Zoom), $699 USD (in person)

courses.title: Trimatri® Reiki Level I | Self-Paced Online Training & Attunement
courses.description: Her Level I training as a self-paced Udemy course: video lessons, a training manual, guided practices and a distance attunement scheduled once the course is finished. A Level II practitioner course is due in November 2026.
courses.price: Price set on Udemy (varies with promotions)

courses.title: Intuition Development: Spirit Guides + Divination Tools
courses.description: An on-demand course of more than three hours of video with a forty-page manual, covering the 'clairs', connecting with spirit guides, automatic writing and divination tools, with live demonstrations.
courses.price: Price set on Udemy (varies with promotions)

courses.title: 11/11 Energy Activation & Remote Reiki Healing
courses.description: An online group session on 11 November in which she sends Trimatri Reiki remotely and shares channelled messages from her guides. A replay is available to download for thirty days.

free_resources.title: Morning Body Scan For Presence + Heart Light Activation
free_resources.description: A guided morning body scan that settles attention in the body and ends with a visualisation of light in the heart. Free on Insight Timer.

free_resources.title: Cord Cutting Meditation: Call Your Energy Home
free_resources.description: A guided visualisation for releasing energetic ties to people and situations and gathering your own energy back. Free on Insight Timer.

free_resources.title: Journey Through the Chakras with the Akashic Records (free email series)
free_resources.description: A free weekly email series that takes one chakra at a time, with simple ways to look after the energy body and messages she receives from the Akashic Records about each centre. A preparation PDF comes with it.
